results.instruction: Place the disassembled parts of the mouse on a flat surface.
Pick up the bottom casing of the mouse.
Align the internal components with the bottom casing.
Insert the internal components into the bottom casing.
Ensure all components are properly seated within the casing.
Take the top casing of the mouse.
Align the top casing with the bottom casing.
Press the top casing onto the bottom casing to secure it.
Check that the mouse is fully assembled and secure.
Locate the screw holes on the bottom of the mouse.
Insert a screw into one of the screw holes.
Use a screwdriver to tighten the screw.
Repeat the process for the remaining screw holes.
Ensure all screws are tightly secured.
Place the fully assembled mouse on the table.
Connect the USB cable to the mouse.
Verify that the mouse is functioning correctly.
